services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: At Cruise San Diego, our Sunset Cruise lets you experience a “sunset” side of Mission Bay that very few get to see, with our unique vessel designed especially for bay cruises, relaxing atmosphere, and awe-inspiring Pacific sunsets you are sure to enjoy this boat ride like no other. 75 Minutes About This tour was designed specifically for anyone seeking a personal touch to an average sunset cruise. Explore the pristine waters of our Mission Bay lagoon on our year round cruise inside this beautiful bay. You will enjoy a great selection of music and alcoholic beverages, 75 Minutes • All Ages • Booking In Advance Encouraged • Date Night!

services.name: Daytime Booze Cruise
services.desc: Where day drinking and gorgeous bay views come together to create a fun and relaxing experience. It's like a rooftop bar on the water with indoor and outdoor seating available! Our full on-board bar features local beers, wines and signature cocktails is a fun and relaxing way to spend an afternoon or evening! Plus, you might even get to see a seal or dolphin, how cool would that be?! Join 60 Minutes • Fun, Relaxing & Delicious!

services.name: Cruise to "I Do"
services.desc: Join us for our Cruise to "I Do" An Open-House Wedding Adventure Highlighting the adventurous aspect of having a wedding on a cruise. 2 Hours About: Tired of the same old wedding mixer experience? Join us for our showcase event and get to experience what a wedding aboard the Ohana looks and feels like. Enjoy Delicious Cocktails, Amazing Food, and Stunning Views aboard the Ohana! Meet our Professional Vendors Lily Tran - Slay Events Hilary Bateman - Little House Of Flowers Genevra Sullivan - Culinary Special 2 hours • All ages welcome!

services.name: Light Show Bay Cruise
services.desc: Cruise around Mission Bay at night with front-row views of SeaWorld’s spectacular light show above the water. 60-75 Minutes • Booking In Advance Encouraged • All Ages

services.name: Valentine Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Valentines Sunset Cruise Looking for a romantic and relaxing outing, while enjoying the evening sunset? Our Valentine Sunset Cruise is a perfect start or end to your special Valentine’s weekend. Your trip will begin with watching the sunset over the Pacific while listening to romantic music, followed by a beautiful cruise around Mission Bay taking in the sights with the warm twilight glow in the horizon. We have popular San Diego guitarist and musician, Joseph Angelastro playing live music during each Valentine Sunset Cruises. Cruise also includes a complimentary glass of champagne. This 75 Minutes • Great For Couples! • Book In Advance • Live Music + Complimentary Champagne

Whether you’re dreaming of a romantic private sunset cruise San Diego-style, planning a special celebration, a team outing or just want to kick back and enjoy a gorgeous sunset boat ride, we make your golden hour picture-perfect.

quotes.author: JS
quotes.text: It was a very pleasant cruise! We haven't spent much time in Mission Bay, so it was nice to see and learn about the area. Great drinks from the bar, great music, and the Captain and crew were absolutely fantastic. We even got to watch the Sea World fireworks, which was an added bonus. Would definitely do this cruise again or try one of their other cruises.

quotes.author: Jonnie
quotes.text: We took this cruise during our trip to San Diego for our one year anniversary, and it was perfect! The staff was amazing, knowledgeable and calming. They have a bar on board and provide blankets after it gets cool. The timing of everything on the cruise was perfect and we saw a beautiful sunset in the bay. Great for anyone who wants a nice, relaxing time.

quotes.author: 92OB107
quotes.text: We cruised San Diego Bay for two hours with Cruise San Diego. We chartered the boat for the final night of our family reunion. Great communication from them throughout the process. I know they also do whale watching cruises as well as other cruises. I recommend them for the organization, the incredibly convivial crew, and the wonderful experience.

The staff was wonderful...so friendly. Get there early because a line develops and the seating is open seating, first come, first sit. We had a lovely time. We saw some seals and pelicans and the boat captain shared some knowledge about the wildlife. There's a bar and great music...a little something for everyone. We had fun and would do it again!

My husband and I went on a Friday night sunset cruise and we really enjoyed it! The crew was so fun and answered questions about wildlife and helped make us feel extremely comfortable offering blankets and anything else we might need. The crew was awesome. I can’t say enough wonderful things about our trip! We had a wonderful time.
JOIN OUR TOP-RATED SAN DIEGO CRUISES & BOAT CHARTERS!
